project_type: Vite + React + TypeScript SPA (EaseMyOffice CRM) with TanStack Router + TanStack Query and Supabase backend
build_system: Bun + Vite. Scripts in package.json: dev, build (vite build), test (vitest run), lint (eslint), format (prettier).
test_framework: Vitest (unit tests colocated as src/lib/*.test.ts). Pure maths libraries are DB-free and tested with concrete values; e.g. command-center.test.ts (14 cases), b2b-analytics.test.ts (22 cases), report-period.test.ts (12 cases). ~243 tests across the suite, currently green.
verification_instructions: Run the full gate and confirm all pass: (1) `./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit` for type-check (npx may not be on PATH, call the binary directly), (2) `bun run build`, (3) `bun run test`. All three MUST be green before finishing. No Docker. No push/PR (orchestrator publishes).
snapshot_or_generated_files: None relevant. TanStack Router generates src/routeTree.gen.ts but this task does not add routes, so it should not change.
setup_instructions: cd /projects/sandbox/Easemyoffice && bun install (if node_modules missing). The repo is on branch main, clean, synced with origin/main @ ee7aa10.
environment_constraints: Work only in /projects/sandbox/Easemyoffice. Ignore the empty repo at /projects/sandbox/easemyofficecollab98. Cannot push or open PRs. Validation is host-based via tsc + bun build + vitest (no Docker, no external network needed).
contribution_requirements: Changes must be strictly additive and backward-compatible: no other dashboards, routes, or pages may regress. Keep the command center admin-only (it is only rendered under `dashView === 'command' && isAdmin` in src/routes/_authenticated/dashboard.tsx). Keep every safeSelect read defensive (returns [] on error, never throws). Keep KPI drill-downs working. Date comparisons in this codebase use YYYY-MM-DD strings built from LOCAL date parts (not new Date(iso)) to avoid UTC drift; follow that convention.
key_patterns: 1) Pure, injectable-clock aggregation maths live in src/lib (command-center.ts, b2b-analytics.ts, report-period.ts) and are unit-tested with concrete values; put ALL new period/date logic there, not in the component or the query. 2) src/lib/report-period.ts already exports resolvePeriod(id, {from,to,now}) returning BOTH fromISO/toISO (for timestamptz columns) AND fromDate/toDate (for YYYY-MM-DD date columns) plus a `previous` window and `bucket`; PeriodId is 'today'|'this_week'|'this_month'|'custom' with PERIOD_OPTIONS. REUSE this rather than reinventing date math. It may be extended (e.g. add 'this_quarter'|'this_year'|'all') with new tests. 3) Filter UI precedent: src/routes/_authenticated/bookings.tsx uses a shadcn Select for Today/This week/This month; src/routes/_authenticated/leads/index.tsx uses a Select plus a Popover+Calendar for a specific date and a custom range (mode='single' and mode='range'). shadcn primitives exist at src/components/ui/{select,popover,calendar,card}.tsx. date-fns v4 is available (format, startOfDay, etc.). 4) TanStack Query caching: queryKey MUST include the filter so changing the filter refetches; commandCenterQuery currently uses queryKey ['admin-command-center'] with staleTime 60s.
